About this item

  • 7 Cooking Functions: Pressure cook, slow cook, sauté, steam, cook rice, make yogurt, or keep your meals warm, all in one compact device.
  • Mini and Mighty: Easy to store, offering the same cooking surface as an 8-inch pan
  • Fun Sized Capacity: The 4-quart capacity is perfect for up to 4 servings, ideal for students, singles, and small families
  • Cooking Status at a Glance: Progress indicator lets you monitor your cooking status with ease
  • Intentionally Convenient: Anti-spin design ensures the pot stays steady for effortless stirring and sautéing
  • Colorful Design: The Rosewater finish adds a lovely modern touch to your kitchen
  • Good Food Done Faster: Cook up to 70% faster compared to slow cooking methods.
  • Quick Cleanup: No more fighting about who has to do the dishes. Dishwasher-safe lid and cooking stainless steel pot make cleaning a breeze
  • Proven Peace of Mind: Features over 10 proven safety features, including overheat protection and an auto-sealing locking lid
  • Power-Packed Performance and A Little Extra: 800 watts, 120 V 60 Hz, UL & ULC Listed. Includes a versatile stainless steel steam rack

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
